pr_url.description: GitHub PR URL (https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123), owner/repo#123, or #123 when the git remote resolves the repository.

fix.description: Run the execution steps: dispatch flow-orchestrator with the fix plan, merge into the reviewed PR's head branch, and answer every comment. Never inferred — absent this flag the skill produces a plan and stops.

context_doc.description: Path to a job context document, e.g. <JOBS_ROOT>/<job>/ai/context.md. Optional and non-blocking.

comment_ids.description: Restrict the run to these collected comment ids. Every excluded comment is still listed, with that as its reason — a filter that removes silently reads as nobody having commented.

max_fix_rounds.description: Ceiling on review/fix rounds, passed to flow-orchestrator as a constraint. It can only lower that skill's own attempt budget, never raise it.

operator_confirmed.description: REQUIRED whenever `fix` is true and this skill is running under dispatch. A subagent has no user to answer the Step 9 confirmation, and --fix merges third-party review comments into somebody's pull request: without this the run is BLOCKED, never defaulted. `plan_digest` binds the approval to the plan that was actually shown.
